name: @mwaeckerlin/hindsight
description: Docker image of the Hindsight agent memory server, with its models and embedded PostgreSQL, and no tool to pivot with

scripts.test: npm run test:docs && npm run test:unit && npm run test:image && npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:unit: python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/unit -v && node --test control-plane/start.test.cjs control-plane/prepare-base-path.test.cjs
scripts.test:image: npm run build && bash tests/image-contract.sh mwaeckerlin/hindsight=dash mwaeckerlin/hindsight:control-plane
